description: 2 tactical challenges for White in the Légal Trap. Offer the queen with 6.Nxe5! and deliver the most famous mate in chess.

drills.briefExplanation: 6.Nxe5! Bxd1?? 7.Bxf7+ Ke7 8.Nd5# — the queen sacrifice that mates.
drills.description: White to play. Black pinned the knight with 5...Bh5 — spring the Légal Trap with 6.Nxe5!.
drills.explanation: The immortal Légal Trap: 6.Nxe5! offers the queen — and if Black greedily plays 6...Bxd1??, White mates in two: 7.Bxf7+ Ke7 8.Nd5#. The bishop on f7 and the knight on d5 weave a mating net the black king cannot escape, with his own queen on d8 blocking the flight. One of the most beautiful ideas in all of chess.
drills.name: The Légal Mate

drills.briefExplanation: 7.Bxf7+ Ke7 8.Nd5# — find the forced mate after Black takes the queen.
drills.description: White to play. Black took the queen — now find the mate.
drills.explanation: The finish of the Légal Trap as a pure mating puzzle: 7.Bxf7+! drags the king out, and after the forced 7...Ke7, 8.Nd5# is mate — the knight covers the escape squares while the bishop on f7 seals the net. Drill this pattern until you see it instantly; it recurs in many forms.
drills.name: Finding the Mate
